new_branch_candidates.title: 16,5 milioane de euro pentru locuri de munca in Dolj si Gorj
new_branch_candidates.claim_boundary: The official ADR Sud-Vest Oltenia / PDDTJ surface documents a current employment-support funding intervention for Dolj and Gorj. Funding allocation, subsidy design and implementation channels are policy/supply context only. They do not measure digital or AI competence, AI-specific skill-gap prevalence, unmet AI-specific employer demand, willingness to train, representativeness or causality. S87 contributes zero H1-H5 points and project/program activity is not used as evidence of need.
